activity.notes: John I of Brabant won the Limburg succession conflict at the Battle of Worringen in 1288 and thereafter held the Duchy of Limburg in addition to Brabant. ATLAS records this as a separate concurrent sovereign Activity because Limburg remained a distinct duchy and title. The record remains at year granularity because secondary references differ on exact transition and death-day details.

sources.title: Introduction — Medieval Dutch Literature in its European Context
sources.citation_text: Cambridge University Press states that John I's victory at Worringen in 1288 settled the Limburg succession war in his favor and that he acquired the duchy of Limburg.

sources.title: Brabant: Herzogtum — Deutsche Digitale Bibliothek
sources.citation_text: The German Digital Library identifies Johann I as Duke of Brabant from 1268-1294 and, from 1288, also Duke of Limburg.
